messages.subject: spec-panel probe: Review Loop present
messages.body: I invoked /sc:spec-panel once through the Skill tool with --help-probe-only and stopped once the command text loaded; I ran no panel and wrote no file. The loaded text has a '## Review Loop' section whose first line is '1. **Mode**: `--re-review` applies to `--mode critique` only; without both `--re-review` and `--baseline` the run is a first review of the full document, ...', and the Usage line does end with '[--re-review <prior-findings-file> --baseline <saved-copy>]'. I cannot give an exact line count because the tool output has no line numbers (roughly 300+ lines, unverified), and nothing else is left to do.
